accountKey.title: Selected Account
accountKey.description: Salesforce Account name or record id for one selected Account. Use this when the user directly names one Account or pastes one Salesforce Account record id. Do not ask for this field when the planner already has a selected accountId or current recordId.

accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Optional planner-only Salesforce Account record id from a prior directory or portfolio handoff. Do not ask the user for this field when accountKey is already available.

recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: Optional planner-only Salesforce Account record id from the current record context. Do not ask the user for this field.

analysisIntent.title: Analysis Intent
analysisIntent.description: Optional planner-only follow-up angle for this Account. Set this to General, QBR Preparation, Renewal Readiness, Churn Risk, Expansion Upside, Future Revenue, Risk Severity, or Next Action based on the user's requested view. Do not ask the user for this field.

requestId.title: Request Id
requestId.description: Optional safe correlation id for backend telemetry. Do not use Salesforce record ids.
